final: WITH r AS (SELECT d.A3 AS region, AVG(CASE WHEN t.type='PRIJEM' THEN t.amount WHEN t.type='VYDAJ' THEN -t.amount END) AS avg_amt, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM trans t JOIN account a ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id GROUP BY d.A3), m AS (SELECT AVG(avg_amt) AS mu FROM r) SELECT AVG(r.avg_amt) AS mean_avg_amount, AVG(r.cnt) AS mean_txn_count, AVG(r.avg_amt - m.mu) AS mean_excess FROM r, m WHERE r.avg_amt > m.mu
